decision.summary: Do not bypass the exact pruned Algorithm 5 schedules for the native GF8 AVX2 T=16 maximum-loss fringe. The regular and pruned executors are effectively tied, with no credible five-percent production region.
decision.kill_criterion: Reject when a broad screen and counterbalanced confirmation fail to show a statistically credible improvement of at least five percent in a coherent target region.
decision.reason: The 288-cell screen produced a 1.003423 geometric ratio and only 164 wins. Five-round paired ABBA confirmation put every target and boundary interval within 1.42 percent of parity; several point estimates favored pruning.

hypothesis.candidate: For pass-local aligned work from 64 through 512 bytes, omit immutable exact input and output schedules and execute the mature regular Algorithm 5 kernels.
hypothesis.control: The same executable with --force-tiled, which retains the exact pruned schedules.

provenance.authority: directional rejection evidence from one immutable dirty-candidate binary; it is not promotion evidence

broad_screen.method: One process pair per cell with process order alternated by cell; 11 retained timing samples, four warmups, and reuse 128.
broad_screen.ratio_semantics: pruned execution time divided by regular candidate execution time; values above one favor the candidate

paired_confirmation.method: Five independent rounds per cell. Each round used ABBA or BAAB process order, two invocations per role, 21 retained timing samples, five warmups, and reuse 256.
paired_confirmation.interval: Two-sided Student-t 95 percent interval over the five paired round log ratios, df=4.

correctness_and_safety.independent_static_review: No semantic defect found; eligibility was fail-closed and arithmetic was unchanged.
correctness_and_safety.release_route_matrix: PASS for every K=17..28, R=9..16, two maximum-loss patterns, B=63/64/65/128/256/512/1024, forced-pruned controls, one-shot, scalar, GF16, K16/K29, and partial-loss neighbors.
correctness_and_safety.release_neighbor_ctest: PASS 7/7: high_direct_production, context_backends, public_api_contract, decode_high_acceptance, high_pruned_legacy, high_t32_tiny_schedule_policy, legacy_golden.
correctness_and_safety.reduced_field_builds: PASS GF8-only and GF16-only field-options production gates.
correctness_and_safety.clang18_asan_ubsan: PASS focused route matrix with leak detection and undefined-behavior halt; peak RSS 249344 KiB.

conclusion.interpretation: T=16 has too little schedule-interpreter overhead for regular execution to provide a robust win. The apparent 1.4 percent 512-byte screen advantage disappeared under counterbalancing, showing that process-order drift dominated the unpaired signal.
conclusion.action: Remove the candidate bypass and test-only route instrumentation. Retain the exact pruned schedules for all T=16 production calls.
conclusion.next_step: Pursue structural work with a larger expected margin, such as T8 full-parity generated terminals, K3/R3 T4 terminals, or reducing staged shard-data scratch.
